name: devserver

author: superpenguin612

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Sessions
commands.description: Open a tmux session or start one for a repo.

commands.title: Waiting Agents
commands.description: Agents waiting on me, asks first.

commands.name: new-task
commands.title: New Claude Task
commands.description: Start claude with a task in a project's session.

commands.description: Load, memory, disk and waiting agents.
